scripts.build: npm run build -w @fg/shared && npm run build -w @fg/api -w @fg/worker -w @fg/web
scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w @fg/shared && npm run build -w @fg/api -w @fg/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @fg/shared && tsc -p apps/api --noEmit && tsc -p apps/worker --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
scripts.test:unit: npm run build -w @fg/shared && vitest run packages
scripts.test:invariants: npm run build -w @fg/shared && vitest run tests
scripts.test:chaos: npm run build -w @fg/shared && CHAOS=1 vitest run tests/chaos.test.ts
